message.elysium.altar.overworld_only: The harvest sanctuary must be awakened beneath the Overworld sky.
message.elysium.altar.pillars: Each of the four pillars must be three upright stripped birch logs tall.
message.elysium.altar.hay: Place four hay bales at the diagonal offerings, two blocks out in each direction.
message.elysium.altar.sky: The altar must see the open sky.
message.elysium.altar.sunset: Offer wheat when the Overworld sun is setting.
message.elysium.altar.sigil_present: A sigil is already resting in the altar.
message.elysium.altar.sigil_inserted: The sigil settles into the stone. Complete the shrine, then offer wheat at sunset.
message.elysium.altar.needs_sigil: The hollow in the altar awaits a Sigil of Elysium.
message.elysium.altar.offer_wheat: The sigil waits for an offering of wheat at sunset.
message.elysium.altar.awakened: The sanctuary awakens. Touch the altar with an empty hand to enter.
message.elysium.travel.unavailable: Elysium is unavailable. Check that its dimension data is installed.
message.elysium.travel.no_landing: No safe landing could be found. The sanctuary leaves you here.
message.elysium.travel.dismount: Dismount and leave passengers behind before using the sanctuary.
message.elysium.travel.cooldown: Let the last crossing settle for a moment.
message.elysium.travel.fallback: Your old path was obstructed. The sanctuary returned you near your Overworld spawn.
title.elysium.arrival.subtitle: The fields remember only golden hours.
tooltip.elysium.forge_survey: Use in Elysium to survey the old Forge entrances.
tooltip.elysium.survey_again: Sneak-use to begin a new survey from here.
tooltip.elysium.chain_resonator: Use to listen for a Chain of Tartarus.
tooltip.elysium.forge_memory: Sneak-use to recall the hearth's bearing.
tooltip.elysium.anchor_heard: A second voice sleeps within the iron.
message.elysium.forge.outside: These records and instruments answer only within Elysium.
message.elysium.forge.record.survey: The archive remembers an old mountain foundry. Use the Surveyor's Folio to find its entrance. A fresh book can take another copy of these records.
message.elysium.forge.record.ledger: The Keeper's Ledger describes the missing First Flame. Its account has been copied into your book on first reading; offer a fresh book for another copy.
message.elysium.forge.record.bindings: The inscription connects the cold hearth to the great chains. Its account has been copied on first reading; offer a fresh book for another copy.
message.elysium.forge.relic: A small instrument answers your touch. The Chain Resonator remembers this hearth.
message.elysium.forge.hearth: The hearth is cold. Ordinary fuel cannot replace its missing heart. Read the Keeper's Ledger in the archive workshop. If your instrument is lost, an amethyst shard can tune a replacement here.
message.elysium.forge.no_memory: This instrument has no memory of a hearth.
message.elysium.forge.survey_disabled: No structure survey can be made in this world: structure generation is disabled.
message.elysium.forge.survey_pending: Your instrument is still listening. You can keep walking while it searches.
message.elysium.forge.survey_busy: Other surveys are still being read. Try again shortly.
message.elysium.forge.survey_missing: These records cannot find that kind of landmark in this realm.
message.elysium.forge.survey_started: You begin a survey of the surrounding mountains. You can keep walking while the instrument listens.
message.elysium.forge.survey_empty: Nothing answered within this survey. Travel farther into the mountains, then try again.
message.elysium.forge.survey_changed: The survey was interrupted. Try the instrument again.
message.elysium.forge.survey_found: The folio marks a mountain entrance near X %s, Z %s. Use it again for a bearing.
message.elysium.forge.chain_found: A low note answers from the mountains. Use the resonator for a bearing, then follow the exposed chain down through the rock.
message.elysium.forge.distance.near: very close; search this part of the mountain
message.elysium.forge.follow_chain: The note travels down the chain. Follow it through the stone and touch the instrument to the terminal anchor at the bottom.
message.elysium.forge.anchor: The anchor answers. Something immense carries the note beyond this chamber. Your first reading leaves a written account; the resonator can still recall the Forge's bearing.
lore.elysium.survey.1:
THE LAST SURVEY

Our hearths still warm the houses. The great hearth has been cold longer than anyone remembers. The road to it survives in the mountains, beneath a copper-marked doorway.
lore.elysium.survey.2: Look for the old survey workshops on the high shoulders. Their roofs have opened to the sky, but the archives were built to endure. The same copper seal marks the foundry entrance.
lore.elysium.survey.3: Use the Surveyor's Folio beneath Elysium's sky. It reads the surrounding mountains in its own time. When it finds a doorway, follow its bearing. Far from home, crouch and use it to begin a fresh survey.
lore.elysium.survey.4: Cartographers and librarians keep copies for travellers. No oath is required. If the harvest is enough for you, close this book and live well. The old work can wait.
lore.elysium.ledger.1:
THE UNFINISHED WORK

We named it the Forge of Hephaestus. Every hammer in the valley remembers a smaller part of its work. Here, even the anvils were built to outlive their makers.
lore.elysium.ledger.2: The runners carried a light too heavy for lanterns. The bellows breathed without wind. At their centre rested the First Flame. Coal leaves only ash in its empty socket.
lore.elysium.ledger.3: The First Flame was taken below, into the keeping of the one who watches the bindings. The great chains still carry an echo of it through the mountain. Listen at their deepest anchors.
lore.elysium.ledger.4: Touch the cold hearth. A small resonator remains for those who would understand. Use it to hear the direction of a chain. Crouch and use it to recall the hearth you left behind.
lore.elysium.ledger.5: We left the hammer raised. We left the channels clean. We did not promise that the world would stay the same when the work resumed. Before bringing back the fire, learn what its absence preserves.
lore.elysium.bindings.1:
ON THE BINDINGS

The mountains grew around the iron. Most travellers see only a dark curve against pale stone. Below it, the links continue where no road was ever cut.
lore.elysium.bindings.2: Follow the chain through the rock. Where it finally enters open air again, a vaulted chamber holds its terminal anchor. The galleries were made for keepers who listened to the strain.
lore.elysium.bindings.3: The resonator must touch the lowest iron at the central plinth. A chain high on a cliff carries too many echoes. At the anchor, the note has only one place left to go.
lore.elysium.bindings.4: Tartarus is held by more than stone. The First Flame and its keeper belong to that older work. The quiet above continues while the bindings hold. Looking upon them makes no demand of the sun.
lore.elysium.anchor.1:
A VOICE IN THE IRON

The first note is yours. The second arrives long after the instrument has fallen silent. It comes through the anchor beneath your hand.
lore.elysium.anchor.2: For a moment the cold iron remembers heat: a furnace without smoke, a hammer waiting in the dark, and something vast attending to the tension of the chains.
lore.elysium.anchor.3: You have found one of the bindings. Beyond this chamber, others answer. The instrument keeps their echo. Above, the golden afternoon continues. The hearth remains cold.
